CONCEPT_DISTRIBUTED_SYSTEMS.name: Distributed Systems
CONCEPT_DISTRIBUTED_SYSTEMS.definition: A collection of autonomous computing elements that appears as a single coherent system

CONCEPT_LOAD_BALANCING.name: Load Balancing
CONCEPT_LOAD_BALANCING.definition: Distributes incoming network traffic across multiple servers to ensure no single server bears too much demand

CONCEPT_CACHING.name: Caching
CONCEPT_CACHING.definition: Storing frequently accessed data in fast storage layers to reduce database load

CONCEPT_DATABASE_DESIGN.name: Database Design
CONCEPT_DATABASE_DESIGN.definition: The process of producing a detailed data model of a database including constraints and normalization

CONCEPT_SHARDING.name: Sharding
CONCEPT_SHARDING.definition: Horizontal partitioning of data across multiple database instances to improve scalability

CONCEPT_REPLICATION.name: Replication
CONCEPT_REPLICATION.definition: Copying data from one database server to others to improve availability and fault tolerance
